## C057 complete — explicit ownership and execution release

Owner `interactive-reach06-comparison-admission-audit-20261027-c057-9f3c` explicitly closes the source scope and exclusive window from comments 6456810009 and 6457106372 at observed 2026-10-28 00:22:43 UTC. All three reviewers are completed and fully paused; root has no active validation, download, transfer or background process. All C057 writer, validation, execution, packaging and publication ownership is released now. This is an explicit release, not an expiry inference. No main integration lease was acquired.

**Publication:** [draft PR #54](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/pull/54), branch `work/reach06-comparison-admission-20261027-c057-9f3c`, final commit `3b82b5bd74495850e08cf8b4f51daca0342f9882`, tree `37e4a53d6bb6a052bd2a53e74b73d720633b467e`, stacked on final C056 `8287be55a21c28320aa11895cadd29c68ae18f90`. All 59 additions / 3,732,519 bytes were read from the immutable remote commit and matched exactly. All 3,059 parent files retain their blobs, modes and sizes. Publication reconciliation preserved all 102 preexisting branch heads and 32 preexisting open PR heads, with totals of 103 branches and 33 open PRs.

**Actual checks:** three final six-file audits completed 79 substantive checks; three source-location correction groups were applied and reread; zero unresolved report-review findings remain. The unchanged documentation checker passed its first attempt: 29 sources, 233 sections, 260 documents, 1,942 local links and 94 anchors. The metadata audit passed all 12 groups on its first attempt. Both commands recorded 927 stable inputs. Acquisition failures, exact recovery and actual validation remain separately documented.

**Source result:** transfer to atan is UNPROVED and stops. The C030/current comparison source is byte-identical, but no complete supported funding attribution was found for all optional setup, repeated and rejected admission work. A conditional, unexecuted helper-entry dictionary witness also identifies a passive-storage premise; natural original-recording reachability was not established. Historical C030 acceptance is unchanged. The three final report reviews do not resolve these technical questions.

**Handoff:** the verified 62-file portable package contains the 59 exact repository additions plus README, publication readback and hash manifest. ZIP SHA-256: `d5c6f7501b5c74d71257a6c107e5a3f785af48f9ddcd3ab72de2f0c9c57a7f8c`; 830,676 bytes. Archive CRCs, 183 length/hash comparisons and 43 JSON parses passed. The package intentionally records that it was assembled before this explicit closure. Saving the ZIP, README and handoff to the user's Library was blocked by automatic approval review; no new Library item was observed and no transfer is active. The GitHub publication and local handoff are complete; delivery authorization is separate from repository ownership.

**Next bounded task:** C058 is only the explicit, unadopted versioned accounting and passive-authority decision proposal in checkpoint-057-next-scope.json. It must define semantic work and funding for setup, fresh proofs and rejects, supported storage/mutation/lifetime premises, lower-limit and failure-order requirements, and independent evidence. It does not adopt changed rules, choose an atan schedule, change shared contracts or select product execution. Reconcile live governance, both STATUS records, all relevant heads/PRs, CI and worker state before claiming a fresh owned continuation branch from actual final C057.

Final live checks confirm this branch and PR54 remain at the final commit, PR54 is open/draft/unmerged, main remains `2bb4588e121fcfe99b4d42c734b15b38362f3642`, and no queued/in-progress workflow runs exist. The earlier empty final-head workflows/statuses are not passed CI. No product imports, endpoints, numerical replays, original/candidate requests, collectors, runtime tests, benchmarks, archived-driver execution, hosted dispatch or main integration occurred.

Original28 remains **24/28 historical**; **P11, P16, P23 and L03 remain unresolved**; **C035 remains held, including adverse timing**. All original limits, horizons/fps/helpers, fixtures, independent oracles, equations, tolerances and outstanding release gates are preserved. The full OntoKin goal remains incomplete.
